notes.title: 1.1 Update !
notes.notes: [p]We’re rolling out a major update for [i]HELP! My New Roommate is a Hung Goth Futanari Ghost![/i] and it’s the biggest one yet. This update brings a lot of quality of life improvements, technical polish, and brand new content.[/p][p][b]What’s New[/b][/p][list][*][p]Controller Support for a smoother way to play[/p][/*][*][p]Steam achievements to mark your progress and discoveries[/p][/*][*][p]Graphical bug fixes for a cleaner presentation[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded story content with new scenes to uncover[/p][/*][*][p]Skippable Poop segments so you can pace the story your way[/p][/*][*][p]Improved soundtrack with new mixes and added sound effects[/p][/*][/list][p]This update is about refining the experience while pushing the story forward. Whether you’re playing for the first time or coming back, it’s a great time to dive in.[/p]
